title: Hⁿ-a.e. point of a Lipschitz image has only Lebesgue-density-point preimages
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ (volume), E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on E, let C ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set and F : ℝⁿ → E a Lipschitz map. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ E, every w ∈ C with F(w) = x is a Lebesgue density point of C: Lⁿ(C ∩ B_r(w))/Lⁿ(B_r(w)) → 1 as r ↓ 0 (closed balls, quotient in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), MeasurableSet C → (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)), ∀ w ∈ C, F w = x → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ volume (C ∩ closedBall w r) / volume (closedBall w r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
